markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (88%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], 0% invasive risk, typical image quality, and model agreement support routine tier-4 review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 88%, Benign 12%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Zero invasive risk; Benign secondary |
| Conformal set | Normal (alpha 10%) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability; 16th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical input; 12/12 regions kept |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%); 1/5 Benign [F5] | One Benign neighbor (BACH_0185, 92%) |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 4, 6) · context · Above-typical embedding score (-1.70 contribution away from invasive) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable embedding score (-1.59 contribution; 0/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 5, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text-only score (-0.68 contribution; caption-inconsistent) [F4] · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 0, 1, 2) · context · 14% inflammatory nuclei (96th percentile across 3 sampled regions) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on dataset deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197); all 12 regions here score 0% risk.
- **Concepts**: Unproven by deletion (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- A benign lesion is present instead of normal tissue (12% Benign probability; 92% similarity to Benign case BACH_0185).
- Elevated HoVer-Net neoplastic-labeled cell density in regions 0, 1, 2 (1466/mm², 86th percentile) reflects true epithelial atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 7, 9**: Verify two-layered lobular epithelium directly, as the normal lobules concept is unreliable (0/20).
2. **Regions 1, 4, 6**: Evaluate the lymphocytic infiltrate differentiating this read from Benign contrast case BACH_0185.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: Inspect sampled epithelium where HoVer-Net counted 58–71 neoplastic-labeled nuclei per region (86th percentile).
